subject.title: feat: retain iMessage tombstones and revisions

question: Should normal `imsgcrawl sync` preserve prior archive rows by default, or should replacement remain the default with merge introduced as an explicit opt-in mode?
rationale: This PR deliberately changes the documented behavior of an existing archive command and its stored-data retention contract; source inspection cannot determine which upgrade semantics maintainers intend to support.

options.title: Keep replacement default
options.body: Retain existing replacement behavior for `sync` and add an explicit merge option after correcting the implementation defects and proving both modes.

options.title: Adopt merge default
options.body: Approve merge as the new default only with explicit migration and upgrade documentation plus proof that existing archives retain intended semantics.

recommendation.title: Keep replacement default
recommendation.body: Retain existing replacement behavior for `sync` and add an explicit merge option after correcting the implementation defects and proving both modes.

likelyOwner.reason: The available commit history ties this contributor directly to the proposed sync and archive-contract design.
